name: Being A Good Stewart
overview: Being a good steward involves faithfully sharing the message of God's kingdom, as Jesus and His disciples actively preached throughout towns and villages (Luke 8:1). It also requires spiritual insight, which Jesus grants by opening understanding so that the Scriptures can be rightly comprehended (Luke 24:45). Ultimately, stewardship is rooted in the eternal Word, who was with God in the beginning and is God Himself, grounding all responsibility in the divine nature of Christ (John 1:1).
